body.intent: The import guide's decision wording is wrong when a document records the owner making or confirming a decision. Step 4 of rhiza guide import forces 'made autonomously by the agent and not confirmed by the owner' for every decision taken from a document; Nebari's import (nebari#66) had 26 decisions its documents attribute to the owner. Owner's pick: credit the owner. The guide must give a second wording form for that case, crediting the owner as the document records it (e.g. '<decided>, made by the owner as recorded in <document>'), still with no quote (they are not the owner's typed words) and a derived-from link to the document's Source; rhiza check must accept both forms.
